title: Best AI For the job?
author: DeliciousFocus2976
selftext:
Hi all! I wanted to use this thread to ask what the best AI agents generally were for modding projects and game porting? I've got a couple things in the works, porting an older game to UE5, occasionally just making mods here and there (like I dunno, adding a base building system to a game that doesn't have one, making use of universal modder).

  
I also plan to develop my own game, a life is strange/telltale style fantasy story game. I want to get as hands on as possible, but the coding will definitely be AI assisted. I've been doing most of my work in Opus with a pro sub, but I run out in a couple days and get little done.

  
Tips? Tricks? Suggestions?

comments.author: sevenoutdb
comments.body: I live Claude Code - it’s goddamn amazing - but I’m paying $100 / month. Amazing - I’ve never hit the limit
